title: Markar Clock Tower — Yazd
visualBrief: Whole independent Markar/Ferdowsi clock tower in Markar Square, Yazd: square base and stepped body, four-sided mechanical clock chamber, plain sloped roof, cornices and integral inscription panels. Primary historian Masarrat’s own republished2026interview reports18m height; museum’s written architecture account specifies square plan/sloped plain roof/four clock faces. Exact nativeQ5902355point fixes identity/location only; base/shaft/clock/roof widths, vertical divisions, taper, recesses/inscription panel layout and precise orientation/finish/grade are bounded reconstruction estimates. No mapped footprint, photographic appearance, exact historic inscription/facade census or surveyed height claimed. Separate Markar school, orphanage, museum and whole roundabout/landscape excluded. Every image/figure/video unused.
